content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My smoke alarm chirps right when I think a secret word. It’s like it responds.
Chirps often signal low battery or test modes. Do the chirps recur at fixed intervals, like every 30–60 seconds?
A steady interval suggests a status alert. If you time three or four gaps with a stopwatch, the interval pattern should show itself.
Consistency aligns with alert behavior rather than word-based triggers. A note of start time and number of chirps makes the pattern easy to reference.
I’ll jot down a few intervals tonight.
